guard: real NATS transport edges reach CotalEndpoint and MeshAgent without flapping readiness
why: The unit transport-liveness suite proves the stop-versus-bind race by replacing connectAndBind
wholesale, so nothing inside that method is under test there. This suite dials a real broker and
gates armPlane3, the last await connectAndBind makes before it reports the endpoint live, which
holds a genuine bind open at its final step while stop() lands. That is the only place the
emitter's own stopped guard is reachable, so it is the only place it can be proven.

mutations.name: a stop landing mid-bind still announces the connection it then tears down
mutations.expectRed: stop during a REAL initial bind never announces the connection it then tears down
mutations.cell: stop during a REAL initial bind never announces the connection it then tears down
